card.name: Unit words after a number
card.fires_on: The unit of time, length or volume right after a number, such as week, days, feet, m, kilometers, hour, L. It often comes where a gap, distance or margin is stated, like 'one week apart' or '2 days off'.

modes.label: Time gap before apart
modes.description: A time unit after a number where the next words give spacing between doses or events.

modes.label: Distance or size units
modes.description: A length or volume unit after a number in a range, height or measurement.
modes.example: They are deployed at 50 to 100<< feet>>.

modes.label: Split unit symbols
modes.description: Part of a unit such as m, L or micro-liters written after a number.
modes.example: 00-800<< m>>. It is divided by a depression occupied

card.writes: It pushes toward words that follow a measured span, such as apart, away, difference and -wide.
card.plain: It fires on the unit right after a number, especially when a gap or distance is being given.
